chapter_text_kjv.1: Then shall the kingdom of heaven be likened unto ten virgins, which took their lamps, and went forth to meet the bridegroom.
chapter_text_kjv.2: And five of them were wise, and five were foolish.
chapter_text_kjv.3: They that were foolish took their lamps, and took no oil with them:
chapter_text_kjv.4: But the wise took oil in their vessels with their lamps.
chapter_text_kjv.5: While the bridegroom tarried, they all slumbered and slept.
chapter_text_kjv.6: And at midnight there was a cry made, Behold, the bridegroom cometh; go ye out to meet him.
chapter_text_kjv.7: Then all those virgins arose, and trimmed their lamps.
chapter_text_kjv.8: And the foolish said unto the wise, Give us of your oil; for our lamps are gone out.
chapter_text_kjv.9: But the wise answered, saying, Not so; lest there be not enough for us and you: but go ye rather to them that sell, and buy for yourselves.
chapter_text_kjv.10: And while they went to buy, the bridegroom came; and they that were ready went in with him to the marriage: and the door was shut.
chapter_text_kjv.11: Afterward came also the other virgins, saying, Adonai (Lord), Adonai (Lord), open to us.
chapter_text_kjv.12: But he answered and said, Verily I say unto you, I know you not.
chapter_text_kjv.13: Watch therefore, for ye know neither the day nor the hour wherein the Son of Adam cometh.
chapter_text_kjv.14: For the kingdom of heaven is as a man travelling into a far country, who called his own servants, and delivered unto them his goods.
chapter_text_kjv.15: And unto one he gave five talents, to another two, and to another one; to every man according to his several ability; and straightway took his journey.
chapter_text_kjv.16: Then he that had received the five talents went and traded with the same, and made them other five talents.
chapter_text_kjv.17: And likewise he that had received two, he also gained other two.
chapter_text_kjv.18: But he that had received one went and digged in the earth, and hid his lord’s money.
chapter_text_kjv.19: After a long time the lord of those servants cometh, and reckoneth with them.
chapter_text_kjv.20: And so he that had received five talents came and brought other five talents, saying, Lord, thou deliveredst unto me five talents: behold, I have gained beside them five talents more.
chapter_text_kjv.21: His lord said unto him, Well done, thou good and faithful servant: thou hast been faithful over a few things, I will make thee ruler over many things: enter thou into the joy of thy lord.
chapter_text_kjv.22: He also that had received two talents came and said, Lord, thou deliveredst unto me two talents: behold, I have gained two other talents beside them.
chapter_text_kjv.23: His lord said unto him, Well done, good and faithful servant; thou hast been faithful over a few things, I will make thee ruler over many things: enter thou into the joy of thy lord.
chapter_text_kjv.24: Then he which had received the one talent came and said, Lord, I knew thee that thou art an hard man, reaping where thou hast not sown, and gathering where thou hast not strawed:
chapter_text_kjv.25: And I was afraid, and went and hid thy talent in the earth: lo, there thou hast that is thine.
chapter_text_kjv.26: His lord answered and said unto him, Thou wicked and slothful servant, thou knewest that I reap where I sowed not, and gather where I have not strawed:
chapter_text_kjv.27: Thou oughtest therefore to have put my money to the exchangers, and then at my coming I should have received mine own with usury.
chapter_text_kjv.28: Take therefore the talent from him, and give it unto him which hath ten talents.
chapter_text_kjv.29: For unto every one that hath shall be given, and he shall have abundance: but from him that hath not shall be taken away even that which he hath.
chapter_text_kjv.30: And cast ye the unprofitable servant into outer darkness: there shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth.
chapter_text_kjv.31: When the Son of Adam shall come in his glory, and all the holy angels with him, then shall he sit upon the throne of his glory:
chapter_text_kjv.32: And before him shall be gathered all nations: and he shall separate them one from another, as a shepherd divideth his sheep from the goats:
chapter_text_kjv.33: And he shall set the sheep on his right hand, but the goats on the left.
chapter_text_kjv.34: Then shall the King say unto them on his right hand, Come, ye blessed of my Father, inherit the kingdom prepared for you from the foundation of the world:
chapter_text_kjv.35: For I was an hungred, and ye gave me meat: I was thirsty, and ye gave me drink: I was a stranger, and ye took me in:
chapter_text_kjv.36: Naked, and ye clothed me: I was sick, and ye visited me: I was in prison, and ye came unto me.
chapter_text_kjv.37: Then shall the righteous answer him, saying, Adonai (Lord), when saw we thee an hungred, and fed thee? or thirsty, and gave thee drink?
chapter_text_kjv.38: When saw we thee a stranger, and took thee in? or naked, and clothed thee?
chapter_text_kjv.39: Or when saw we thee sick, or in prison, and came unto thee?
chapter_text_kjv.40: And the King shall answer and say unto them, Verily I say unto you, Inasmuch as ye have done it unto one of the least of these my brethren, ye have done it unto me.
chapter_text_kjv.41: Then shall he say also unto them on the left hand, Depart from me, ye cursed, into everlasting fire, prepared for the devil and his angels:
chapter_text_kjv.42: For I was an hungred, and ye gave me no meat: I was thirsty, and ye gave me no drink:
chapter_text_kjv.43: I was a stranger, and ye took me not in: naked, and ye clothed me not: sick, and in prison, and ye visited me not.
chapter_text_kjv.44: Then shall they also answer him, saying, Adonai (Lord), when saw we thee an hungred, or athirst, or a stranger, or naked, or sick, or in prison, and did not minister unto thee?
chapter_text_kjv.45: Then shall he answer them, saying, Verily I say unto you, Inasmuch as ye did it not to one of the least of these, ye did it not to me.

threads.title: The few saved, the many lost, and the post-harvest sifting — 2 Esdras (4 Ezra) 7 and 8's articulation of the world-to-come-for-few + the work-shall-follow + the judgment-seat-of-the-Most-High
threads.summary_md: Matt 25's three sifting-parables — the ten-virgins shut-door at vv.10-13, the unprofitable-servant cast-into-outer-darkness at v.30, and the sheep-and-goats-judgment at vv.31-46 — read against the wisdom-stream's direct articulation of the post-harvest-sifting per Red Line #11 in 2 Esdras (4 Ezra) 7 and 8. Four moves: 2 Esdras 8:1 names THE direct verbal-anchor for the world-to-come-for-few substance (*The most High has made this world for many, but the world to come for few*) — the substantial-architecture the shut-door at Matt 25:10 walks; 2 Esdras 8:3 names the direct articulation of the many-created-but-few-saved substance (*There be many created, but few shall be saved*) — the operative-substance of the substantial-many-called-but-few-chosen at Matt 22:14 and the substantial *I know you not* at Matt 25:12; 2 Esdras 7:35 names the work-shall-follow + the reward-shall-be-shewed substance — the substantial-substance the unprofitable-servant walks-into at Matt 25:30's outer-darkness; 2 Esdras 7:33 names the Most-High-on-the-seat-of-judgment substance — the substantial-Davidic-Messianic-throne-of-his-glory the King-of-Yashar'el (Israel) sits-upon at Matt 25:32 + the gathering-of-all-nations + the separation-substance the prophet-Yo'el (Joel) walked at Joel 3:1-14 walks-into. threads.title: The judgment of the kings and the mighty cast down — the Parables of Enoch beside the sheep and the goats at Matthew 25:31-46
threads.summary_md: *When the Son of Adam shall come in his glory, and all the holy angels with him, then shall he sit upon the throne of his glory: And before him shall be gathered all nations: and he shall separate them one from another, as a shepherd divideth his sheep from the goats:* (Matthew 25:31-32). The throne of his glory is Enoch's phrase, and the Parables show who is standing in front of it. *And there shall stand up in that day all the kings and the mighty, And the exalted and those who hold the earth, And they shall see and recognize How he sits on the throne of his glory, And righteousness is judged before him, And no lying word is spoken before him.* (1 Enoch 62:3). The sight of him is what undoes them: *And one portion of them shall look on the other, And they shall be terrified, And they shall be downcast of countenance, And pain shall seize them, When they see that Son of Adam Sitting on the throne of his glory.* (1 Enoch 62:5). They bow too late: *And all the kings and the mighty and the exalted and those who rule the earth Shall fall down before him on their faces, And worship and set their hope upon that Son of Adam, And petition him and supplicate for mercy at his hands.* (1 Enoch 62:9), and they are handed over: *And He will deliver them to the angels for punishment, To execute vengeance on them because they have oppressed His children and His elect* (1 Enoch 62:11). Enoch even records their confession from the darkness: *For we have not believed before Him Nor glorified the name of Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits, [nor glorified our Lord] But our hope was in the sceptre of our kingdom, And in our glory.* (1 Enoch 63:7). That is the goats' *Lord, when saw we thee* in another tongue, the recognition that comes after the door is shut. The fire the goats are sent toward was never made for them in the first place: *Then shall he say also unto them on the left hand, Depart from me, ye cursed, into everlasting fire, prepared for the devil and his angels:* (Matthew 25:41). It was prepared for the Watchers and their master, and Jude and Peter say the same. The goats are the unfruitful among the gathered, sifted out before the reign; the kings and the mighty who possess the earth fall at the Day with the tares abroad; and the verdict is final, *And these shall go away into everlasting punishment: but the righteous into life eternal.* (Matthew 25:46). There is no universal rescue hidden in the chapter, and there is no endless torture of the uninformed either. There is a throne, a shepherd who knows his sheep, and a door that closes.

members_in_this_chapter.member_note: *And one portion of them shall look on the other, And they shall be terrified, And they shall be downcast of countenance, And pain shall seize them, When they see that Son of Adam Sitting on the throne of his glory.* (1 Enoch 62:5). *When the Son of Adam shall come in his glory, and all the holy angels with him, then shall he sit upon the throne of his glory* (Matthew 25:31). Enoch saw that seat and the faces of those who see it — terror, pain, downcast countenance, when they see that Son of Adam sitting on the throne of his glory. The sheep-and-goats judgment opens on the throne the Parables had already set.

*And He will summon all the host of the heavens, and all the holy ones above, and the host of Elohim (God), the Cherubin, Seraphin and Ophannin, and all the angels of power, and all the angels of principalities, and the Elect One, and the other powers on the earth (and) over the water.* (1 Enoch 61:10). *And all the holy angels with him* (Matthew 25:31). Enoch gives the roll: the host of the heavens, the holy ones above, Cherubim, Seraphim and Ophannim, the angels of power and of principalities — and the Elect One among them. The company of the coming was mustered in the Parables before the gospel named it.

*And this Son of Adam whom thou hast seen Shall raise up the kings and the mighty from their seats, [And the strong from their thrones] And shall loosen the reins of the strong, And break the teeth of the sinners.* (1 Enoch 46:4). *And before him shall be gathered all nations: and he shall separate them one from another* (Matthew 25:32). The Son of Adam who separates is the Son of Adam Enoch saw raise the kings and the mighty from their seats and break the teeth of the sinners. The separation is a reversal; the mighty do not keep their seats at it.

*And he shall put down the countenance of the strong, And shall fill them with shame. And darkness shall be their dwelling, And worms shall be their bed, And they shall have no hope of rising from their beds, Because they do not extol the name of Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits.* (1 Enoch 46:6). *Depart from me, ye cursed, into everlasting fire, prepared for the devil and his angels* (Matthew 25:41). Enoch saw what that departure is for the strong: countenance put down, shame, darkness for a dwelling, worms for a bed, no hope of rising — because they did not extol the name of Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits.

*And in the day of our suffering and tribulation He saves us not, And we find no respite for confession That our Lord is true in all His works, and in His judgements and His justice, And His judgements have no respect of persons.* (1 Enoch 63:8). *Depart from me, ye cursed* (Matthew 25:41) is answered in Enoch by the mouths of the kings and the mighty themselves: in the day of their tribulation he saves them not, and their confession comes too late to be anything but true. *Lord, when saw we thee an hungred?* (Matthew 25:44) is the same late confession.

threads.title: The Sheep Divided From The Goats — The Gathered Sifted At The Throne Of His Glory
threads.summary_md: *When the Son of Adam shall come in his glory, and all the holy angels with him, then shall he sit upon the throne of his glory: And before him shall be gathered all nations: and he shall separate them one from another, as a shepherd divideth his sheep from the goats: And he shall set the sheep on his right hand, but the goats on the left.* (Matthew 25:31-33). *All nations* names where the gathered come from. The seed was scattered among all the nations, and at his coming it is gathered out of them — and then sifted. Ezekiel saw the sifting and where it happens: *And I will bring you into the wilderness of the people, and there will I plead with you face to face... And I will cause you to pass under the rod, and I will bring you into the bond of the covenant: And I will purge out from among you the rebels, and them that transgress against me: I will bring them forth out of the country where they sojourn, and they shall not enter into the land of Yashar'el (Israel)* (Ezekiel 20:35, 37-38). The goats are parted from the sheep among the gathered, before the reign — not the nations judged for entry into it. The measure is mercy shown to *one of the least of these my brethren* (Matthew 25:40), and the brethren are the seed: *for which cause he is not ashamed to call them brethren* (Hebrews 2:11). The sheep *inherit the kingdom prepared for you from the foundation of the world* (Matthew 25:34) and enter the land as a kingdom of priests to the nations left alive (Zechariah 14:16); the goats are sent toward *everlasting fire, prepared for the devil and his angels* (Matthew 25:41). The warning was always given to the wheat.
